name: Living Life To The Fullest
overview: Scripture reveals that living life to the fullest is found in walking closely with the Lord, who guides our steps and grants true joy and lasting pleasures (Psalms 16:11; Proverbs 16:9). Delight in God brings fulfillment and the desires of our hearts (Psalms 37:4), while wisdom comes from recognizing the brevity of life and numbering our days rightly (Psalms 90:12). Trusting God's sovereign plans, which are for our peace and hopeful future, guards us against boasting about tomorrow, reminding us to live each day with dependence on His guidance (Jeremiah 29:11; Proverbs 27:1).
